title: Newton strata realization for hypersurfaces via explicit p-adic cohomology
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective hypersurface over a finite field $k$ of characteristic $p$. We address the problem of practically computing the zeta function $Z(X,T)$ of $X$ (equivalently, the point counts $\#X(\mathbb{F}_q)$, where $q = p^n$), and we focus on the case when $7 \leq p < 50$. We use the theoretical framework of the variant of Kedlaya's algorithm in arXiv:archive/0601508, and we use the technique of controlled reduction as described in Costa's Thesis. We define an optimization problem that abstracts the key bottleneck in the implementation of controlled reduction. An algorithm…
